notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Howlsquad Heavy.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.
